name: Sant Joan de Vilatorrada (Spain)
description: Dark green field with a yellow bend sinister and the two towers of the arms, a white tower with black door and windows in the upper hoist and a yellow tower with red openings in the lower fly.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 27 October 2022, approved by the Departament de la Presidència on 8 May 2023 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 12 May 2023; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with a yellow bend sinister 1/10 of the height and the two towers of the arms, each 5/12 of the height and 1/5 of the length.
